name: kaizen
description: Nine standalone skills for building an app with an agent: app-settle writes down what the app is, design-settle settles its look into DESIGN.md, and build-flow, docs-format, ui-build, db-ops and logic-build carry the rules for building a page, a document, UI, SQL and application logic. norms-config writes ten working rules, each negotiable in chat, into the repo's CLAUDE.md. On Claude Code one hook prints the working rules into each session whose CLAUDE.md lacks them; it never refuses or blocks.
